name: Pension To The Disabled Person
benefit: - The pension payable to each person shall be ₹1000/- per annum to those persons having 40% to 70% of disability. - ₹2000/-per annum to those persons having more than 70% of disability.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant's disability must be to the extent of 40% or above then they will be eligible to avail the benefit of same. 
1. The applicant must be a resident of UT Chandigarh for more than 3 years. 
1. The family income of the applicant should not exceed  ₹1.50 lacs annually.
